title: A Battery Is Not Just a Number
title_ja: 電池は一つの数字ではない
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空例。実在の調査結果や特定製品の性能・史実・管理基準の記述ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A fictional consumer organization compares several portable electronic devices and initially plans to rank them according to the operating time advertised by their manufacturers.
sentences.ja: 架空の消費者団体は携帯電子機器を比較し当初メーカーが宣伝する稼働時間で順位づけしようとする。

sentences.en: A volunteer points out that the figure assigned to each product may have been obtained under conditions that differ significantly from the circumstances in which particular customers intend to use it.
sentences.ja: 各製品の数値は個々の顧客が使う状況と大きく異なる条件で得られた可能性があるとボランティアが指摘する。

sentences.en: Someone who occasionally reads short documents might place different demands on a device from someone who frequently records video or uses applications requiring continuous network communication.
sentences.ja: 時折短文書を読む人は頻繁に動画を記録したり常時ネット通信を必要とするアプリを使ったりする人とは異なる負荷を機器にかけるかもしれない。

sentences.en: The organization consequently decides that comparing numbers without explaining their relationship to actual activities could mislead the very people it hopes to assist.
sentences.ja: そこで数値と実際活動の関係を説明せず比較すると支援したい人々を誤解させる恐れがあると判断する。

sentences.en: The volunteers consider constructing several carefully described patterns of use rather than searching for one procedure that represents every possible customer.
sentences.ja: 全顧客を代表する一手順を探すのでなく詳しく記述された複数の利用パターンの構築を検討する。

sentences.en: For each pattern, they would identify which functions were active, how the display was used, and which environmental conditions were relevant to the comparison.
sentences.ja: 各パターンにおいてどの機能を有効にしたか、画面の使用法、比較に関係する環境条件を特定することになる。

sentences.en: They recognize that standardized testing is valuable because it can reduce some sources of variation, even though the resulting figures cannot describe every individual experience.
sentences.ja: 標準化試験は変動要因の一部を減らせるので有用だが結果数値は全個人の経験を説明できないと認識する。

sentences.en: The intended comparison is not a genuine product test; it is a hypothetical exercise about the relationship between measurement procedures and practical decisions.
sentences.ja: 意図した比較は実製品試験ではなく測定手順と実務判断の関係についての仮想練習だ。

sentences.en: During preparation, the volunteers also discuss how a consumer might interpret a small difference between two advertised operating times.
sentences.ja: 準備中に二つの宣伝稼働時間の小差を消費者がどう解釈するかも議論する。

sentences.en: A numerical ranking could imply that one device is consistently superior even if repeated measurements under similar conditions sometimes produce results that overlap.
sentences.ja: 数値順位は類似条件の反復測定で結果が重なる場合でも一方が一貫して優れると示唆し得る。

sentences.en: The organization therefore considers presenting several results and describing uncertainty instead of emphasizing a single apparent winner.
sentences.ja: そこで見かけの勝者一つを強調せず複数結果と不確実性の説明を検討する。

sentences.en: It also distinguishes operating time from other characteristics that may matter to users, such as the availability of charging opportunities during their normal routines.
sentences.ja: 稼働時間と通常日課での充電機会の利用可能性など他の重要特性も区別する。

sentences.en: The imagined report includes a short explanation of its methods before describing what different patterns of use might reveal.
sentences.ja: 仮想報告書は異なる利用パターンが何を明らかにし得るか述べる前に短い手法説明を含む。

sentences.en: Rather than presenting the longest operating time as the only desirable result, it encourages readers to consider the limitations that would actually interfere with their intended activities.
sentences.ja: 最長稼働時間を唯一望ましい結果と示さず予定活動を実際に妨げる限界を考えるよう促す。

sentences.en: A person who can charge a device at convenient intervals might assign less importance to a difference in operating time than a person who needs uninterrupted access for an extended period.
sentences.ja: 都合よい間隔で充電できる人は長時間中断なく利用する必要のある人より稼働時間差を重視しないかもしれない。

sentences.en: The volunteers acknowledge that no hypothetical measurement can establish the performance of a specific device that has not actually been tested.
sentences.ja: 実際に試験していない特定機器の性能を仮想測定で確定できないと認める。

sentences.en: Quantitative comparisons are useful when they make differences easier to investigate without concealing the assumptions required to produce the figures.
sentences.ja: 数量比較は数値生成の前提を隠さず差を調べやすくするとき有用だ。

sentences.en: Their practical significance depends on whether the measured characteristic corresponds to a problem that the reader actually needs to solve.
sentences.ja: 実用的意義は測定特性が読者が実際解決すべき問題に対応するかに依存する。

sentences.en: A measurement can be technically precise while remaining insufficient as a complete description of the experience it is intended to represent.
sentences.ja: 測定は技術的に正確でも表すべき経験の完全な説明には不十分な場合がある。

sentences.en: Responsible product information connects numerical results with the conditions that allow those results to guide meaningful choices.
sentences.ja: 責任ある製品情報は数値結果を意味のある選択に導く条件と結びつける。

questions.prompt: What did the organization originally plan to rank?
options: The physical size of each product.

questions.prompt: Why compare reading and video recording?
options: Reading always consumes more energy than video.
Every customer uses the same functions.
Advertised figures represent no actual conditions.
Different activities can place different demands on a device.

questions.prompt: What would each use pattern specify?
options: Active functions, display use and relevant conditions.

questions.prompt: Why is standardized testing still useful?
options: It reduces some sources of variation for comparison.
It guarantees identical results under all conditions.
It eliminates the need to describe methods.

questions.prompt: What problem might a small numerical difference create?
options: The products must have identical characteristics.
Consumers automatically understand the test variation.
A ranking may exaggerate the certainty of superiority.
questions.explanation_ja: 差の確実性を過大評価。

questions.prompt: What does the organization consider showing?
options: Only the product with the highest number.
Several results with an explanation of uncertainty.
An unrelated list of brand colors.
A guarantee of every user's experience.

questions.prompt: Why might access to charging affect a choice?
options: It changes the practical importance of operating time.
It makes all battery measurements incorrect.
It requires every consumer to use the same device.
It determines every device's physical size.
questions.explanation_ja: 充電機会により重要性が変わる。

questions.prompt: What cannot be established by the hypothetical exercise?
options: The kinds of questions that real testing should address.
The existence of different usage patterns.
Actual performance of an untested device.
Technical measurements become useful for decisions when their conditions and practical relevance are explained.
The largest advertised number always identifies the best product.
Every product must be compared using unrelated procedures.
questions.explanation_ja: 測定条件と実用性を結びつける。
